Class Road

java.lang.Object
Road
public class Road extends Object
Represents a road connection between two Location objects. This class includes validation logic to ensure the physical length is not shorter than the Euclidean distance between the locations.

    • Road

      public Road(RoadType type, double length, int speedLimit, Location source, Location destination)
      Constructs a new Road instance. * @param type The type of the road (e.g., HIGHWAY, COUNTRY).
      Parameters:
      length - The length of the road in kilometers.
      speedLimit - The maximum speed limit allowed on this road.
      source - The starting Location.
      destination - The ending Location.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided length is less than the calculated Euclidean distance.
